definitions.explanation: Describes someone who can wait calmly and does not get annoyed when things take a long time. Literally 'one's temperament is long.' The direct antonym of {気|き}が{短|みじか}い.

examples.japanese: {気|き}が{長|なが}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Patient people are suited to dealing with children.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ずいぶん{気|き}が{長|なが}い⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
examples.english: Continuing the research for ten years — that's quite a long-haul undertaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}が{長|なが}くて、⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧{待|ま}たされて⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わない→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather is even-tempered and doesn't complain no matter how many hours he's kept waiting.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (temperament) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧ (long).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {気|き}が{長|なが}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a patient person
- ⟦{気|き}{長|なが}→気長：20721_kinaga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait patiently (the adverbial form ⟦{気|き}{長|なが}→気長：20721_kinaga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is very common)
- {気|き}が{長|なが}い⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: a long-drawn-out proposition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{我慢強|がまんづよ}い→我慢強い：07164_gamanzuyoi⟧: patient, enduring — stresses putting up with hardship, not just waiting calmly
- ⟦のんびり→のんびり：01596_nonbiri⟧: laid-back — describes an unhurried pace of life rather than tolerance of delay

USAGE:
Applied to a plan rather than a person, {気|き}が{長|なが}い suggests the speaker finds it impractically slow.
